description:
Machine-check a cognition claim: recompute the brain from the
    submitted content and compare against the claimed brain_id and/or
    content_hash. valid=true iff every claimed identifier matches the
    deterministic recomputation (VB3).

brain_id.description: Optional. The claimed brain id to check.
brain_id.title: Brain Id

content.description: The agent file, as a string.
content.title: Content

content_hash.description: Optional. The claimed content hash to check.
content_hash.title: Content Hash

format.description: verdigraph_genome, claude_project_export, openai_assistant, prompt_list or auto (default).
format.title: Format

name: verify_brain
title: Verify brain
